subject.title: feat(sync): forward receipts and chat presence over the webhook

question: Should the established message webhook body remain strictly unchanged by default, with `EventType` limited to users who opt into the new event contract?
rationale: This is a public operator-facing webhook contract: additive JSON is not safely backward compatible for strict decoders or signed-body consumers, and maintainers must choose the permanent compatibility policy.

options.title: Preserve the legacy default
options.body: Keep default message payloads unchanged and provide discrimination only within the explicit receipt/chat-presence opt-in contract.

options.title: Adopt a versioned webhook contract
options.body: Introduce an explicit version or new endpoint/flag for payloads that include a discriminator, leaving existing users on the old schema.

options.title: Accept the breaking default addition
options.body: Document that every existing message receiver must tolerate the new field and treat the body change as an intentional compatibility break.

recommendation.title: Preserve the legacy default
recommendation.body: Keep default message payloads unchanged and provide discrimination only within the explicit receipt/chat-presence opt-in contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed adjacent contributor available from the supplied sync-presence history; ownership of the webhook API itself remains uncertain.
